description: What the record's dated events say about how AI and tech companies ship and where their money goes, by quarter since 2023. Counted from checked claims only, by trend tags a model gives each claim from a fixed list, including whether the claim is about AI or the rest of tech (judged by the announcement, not the company). domain ai or tech keeps one side and adds each company's releases, updates and deals; omit it for both, each row carrying d. summary is the sentence the page leads with (the totals over the quarters returned and the busiest complete quarter), with a topic the topic's. Without topic: product updates per quarter and each theme's count (themes: agents, coding, voice_audio, image_video, reasoning, search, memory_personalization, connectors, enterprise_security, open_weights, health_science, finance_legal, education, commerce_ads, robotics_physical, safety_policy, compute_infra, pricing_access, devices, developer_platform, os_apps, media_entertainment), releases by kind, model releases by company (each company read with its products, as group: true reads it) and tier, deals by kind (funding_round, investment_out, grant_program, capital_commitment, acquisition, partnership, customer, expansion, valuation), the amounts disclosed per currency (as stated, never converted), the latest releases and deals, the largest amounts, who bought whom, countries, partners' kinds, and each source's coverage (sources start on different days: compare shares within a quarter rather than counts across quarters). model_releases lists every model release with its day, maker, tier and themes; with domain ai, cadence gives each company's median days between model releases (and between frontier ones), its latest release and how long ago, and the mix (small and fast, frontier, open weights) in the last two complete quarters against the two before. quarter (YYYY-Qn) without topic is the first quarter returned; the default is the last eight. Without topic each list of claims holds its first rows (limit, default 20, as far as a list fits the result; lists gives each list's total) and the per-company, per-quarter rows are left to /v1/trends. With topic (a theme, a deal kind, model, release for every release, update for every product update or deal for every deal): the checked claims behind it, newest first, in quarter, domain and company when given, as timeline rows with their tags. limit default 50, max 200; offset pages.

company.description: With topic: one company's claims, its records read together; a key from the counts' companies[].key (google, openai, anthropic...)

domain.description: ai or tech; omit for both

limit.description: With topic: claims per page (max 200). Without: the rows each list holds

offset.description: With topic: skip this many claims (next_offset from the previous page)

topic.description: A theme (voice_audio), a deal kind (funding_round, acquisition), model, release, update or deal; omit for the counts

name: trends

claims.description: With topic: the claims behind it

complete.description: false when rows remain: ask again with next_offset

legend.description: What the row fields and why_not codes mean

lists.description: Without topic: each list's rows returned and total
